facts.fact: BoFiNet's annual report says that at the end of financial year 2022/23 it had partnered with four local authorities (Serowe and Mahalapye District Councils, Bobirwa and Boteti Sub District Councils) for the deployment of premises Wi-Fi in their Rural Administration Centres; it gives no total of councils and does not say the service was live.

systems.tiers: four local authorities: two district councils and two sub-district councils; deployment partnerships

85 hotspots in 16 localities; 1,138 premises in 144 villages being connected, among them 165 sites of the Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development (customary courts and tribal administration offices)
206 of 399 gazetted localities connected; the remaining 193 targeted by 2025
4,803 commercial and government premises in 13 towns; no council office named

note: Read as passages. The one fact is a count of councils partnered for deployment, not of offices stated as connected: the parent should read it as preparation. The 206-of-399 localities figure is network coverage of areas and gives no fact; the 165 Ministry of Local Government sites are customary courts and tribal offices under a public Wi-Fi scheme.
